channel.title: Teardown
channel.description: Teardown publishes long-form UX case studies, short UX bites and practical cheatsheets — reverse-engineering how the best products are designed.

item.title: Inside Booking.com's urgency engine
item.description: Few sites push harder. A teardown of Booking.com's scarcity and social-proof machine — what genuinely helps users, and where persuasion tips into pressure.

item.title: How Tinder reduced a decision to a gesture
item.description: Tinder collapsed dating into a single swipe. A teardown of the interaction that reshaped an entire category — and what it traded away.

item.title: How Apple makes the premium choice feel obvious
item.description: Apple's product pages don't sell features — they frame a decision. A teardown of anchoring, comparison and the quiet art of the default upgrade.

item.title: How Robinhood gamified investing — for better and worse
item.description: Robinhood made investing feel as easy as a mobile game. A teardown of the onboarding that opened markets to millions — and the ethics of frictionless finance.

item.title: How Airbnb turns browsing into booking
item.description: Airbnb's search isn't a filter form — it's a confidence-building machine. A teardown of maps, live counts and the gentle nudge from looking to booking.

item.title: How Uber deleted the payment moment
item.description: Uber's biggest UX trick was making payment disappear entirely. A teardown of removing friction by removing the step.

item.title: Why GOV.UK is the gold standard for accessible forms
item.description: No brand flourish, no dark patterns — just forms that anyone, on any device, with any ability, can complete. A teardown of designing for everyone.

item.title: How Stripe makes paying feel safe
item.description: Stripe's checkout removes payment anxiety with relentless detail — formatting, validation and reassurance engineered into every field.

item.title: Figma's navigation scales from doodle to design system
item.description: The same canvas serves a first-time sketcher and a team running a 10,000-component library. A teardown of how Figma's navigation stretches without breaking.

item.title: How Headspace turns meditation into a habit
item.description: Building a daily habit from scratch is brutally hard. Headspace stacks small commitments, friendly nudges and visible progress to make it stick.

item.title: Notion's empty states teach you the product
item.description: A blank page is terrifying. Notion turns every empty surface into a guided, fill-in-the-blank lesson in how the tool works.

item.title: Netflix's sign-up is a masterclass in commitment
item.description: Netflix reorders the classic funnel — show the value, then ask for the plan, then the payment — and removes every reason to bail.

item.title: How Spotify nails first-run personalization
item.description: Spotify turns a cold start into a tailored experience before you've made a single deliberate choice — here's the machinery behind it.

item.title: Why Amazon's checkout still wins
item.description: Friction removed at every step: a teardown of the one-click legacy and the modern checkout flow.

item.title: The psychology behind Duolingo's streak
item.description: How Duolingo turns a counter into a habit — loss aversion, repair mechanics, and gentle nudges done right.

item.title: How Monzo makes opening an account feel effortless
item.description: A teardown of Monzo's mobile sign-up: progressive disclosure, trust cues, and the art of asking for less.
